why_the_overlap_is_this_thin: Not a defect in the oracle. The five roster accounts are 2026 TaxSMA books whose first positive value runs 2026-03-16..2026-07-08, while the vendor's offered periods are calendar-year, trailing-twelve-month and year-to-date ranges anchored well before those dates. A period reaching back before an account's first day would compare a FULL vendor figure against a PARTIAL Opal one, which is the silent version of the thing the tie-out exists to make visible -- so those periods are refused rather than compared short.
act_not_taken_and_why: NO PULL MADE YET, although the trigger is met and the authorisation exists. The tie-out compares against DB-b-1's gold, and that gold is not emitted: the request ranges worth asking for depend on the coverage the emit actually lands. Pulling now would spend a vendor call to ask for periods I cannot yet compare, which is need-shaped reasoning the grant was given for rather than a licence to call early. The pull belongs inside DB-b-3, after the gold exists, with this record as its `overlap_before_pull` and the call counted in `vendor_calls`.
